popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer makes Rhexenor son of Nausithous and brother of Alcinous — slain by Apollo in his hall, leaving Arete as his only child, the queen Odysseus will clasp.

popCulture.title: Arete (mythology)
popCulture.description: Rhexenor's daughter — the Phaeacian queen whose favor Nausicaa and Athena bid Odysseus seek first.

popCulture.title: Alcinous
popCulture.description: Rhexenor's brother — the king who marries Arete and hosts Odysseus; the uncle-niece marriage Homer states without apology.

popCulture.title: Nausithous
popCulture.description: Rhexenor's father — the Poseidon-born founder of Scheria whose two sons split early death and lasting kingship.
